title: Estrategia Web content type
description: One file = one post type, with its taxonomies and fields. The same rules as includes/class-schema.php (the PHP validator is the one that decides; tests/schema.test.mjs fails if the two drift apart). Name limits and the prefix of every name are checked by PHP only.

template.description: Set by the plugin when the definition is copied from one of its templates (client, testimonial, location, project, portfolio). The names the template ships keep the plugin's prefixes; the type name cannot change. Not for hand-written files.

prefix.description: The site's own prefix, checked with tools/buscar-colisiones.mjs. Every name in the file starts with it. eweb_, estrategia_web_, ew_ and wp_ are reserved (except in a definition made from a template).

name.description: The registered post type (the REST route /wp/v2/<name>). Starts with prefix. At most 20 characters: WordPress cuts it silently.

slug.description: Public URL base (and archive). Default: the name without the prefix, with - for _.

supports.description: Default: title, editor, thumbnail, excerpt, revisions. custom-fields is added when there are fields. Without editor, WordPress uses the classic screen (the fields go in a meta box).

show_in_rest.description: false also turns off the block editor and the fields panel.

fields_box.description: Where the fields are edited: sidebar = the «<Singular> details» panel of the block editor; main = a wide meta box in the main area, under the content, with the fields in their groups. A type without editor always gets the meta box.

groups.description: Sections of the main-area meta box, in order. A field joins one with «group». Fields without a group go first.

collapsed.description: Closed until clicked (data a person rarely changes).

oneOf.description: A taxonomy declared in another file, or category / post_tag.

slugPath.description: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, - and /, no slashes at the ends.

slug.description: A URL path, or an object locale → path: {"ca": "restaurants", "es": "restaurantes"}. Registered with the site language's; with WPML (and String Translation) the others become WPML slug translations. Two types or taxonomies cannot share a slug in the same language.

text.description: A string, or an object locale → string: {"ca": "…", "es": "…", "en": "…"}. Picked by the admin or site language: exact locale, then its language, then en, then the first one.

details.description: Title of the fields panel in the editor. Default: «<Singular> details».

featured_image.description: What the featured image is called for this type (e.g. «Static map image»).

name.description: Starts with prefix. At most 32 characters.
The meta key. Starts with prefix.

type.description: rating: 0 (none) to 5, picked as stars. embed: a map or video embed URL; pasting the whole <iframe> keeps its src. local_image: an image of THIS site by theme path (assets/maps/x.webp), site path or same-domain URL. hours: opening hours per day, stored as JSON text {"mo":["08:00-14:00","16:00-20:00"],…} (mo…su; closed days left out).

required.description: Publishing with it empty is refused: a 400 in the block editor; on the classic screen (types without editor) the post stays a draft, or keeps the previous value if it was already published.

default.description: A value the field could store: an option value for select, YYYY-MM-DD for date, a number within min/max, true/false. Not for image or relation.

wpml.description: Default: translate for text and textarea, copy for the rest.

group.description: The key of one of the definition's «groups»: the section of the main-area meta box it goes in.

true_label.description: boolean only: what the estrategia-web/content-field binding shows when it is true. Default: «Yes», translated. "" shows nothing.

false_label.description: boolean only: what the estrategia-web/content-field binding shows when it is false. Default: «No», translated. "" shows nothing.
